sql: select ticker, status, to_char(close_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') close_utc, to_char(expiration_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') exp_utc, to_char(updated_at,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') upd_utc, left(coalesce(title,''),60) title from markets where ticker like 'KXBIGGESTQUAKE-17SEP26%' order by ticker
